name: io.github.shoubhiksaha/notion-large-file-upload
title: Notion Large File Upload
description: Upload local files up to 5 GB to Notion and attach them to pages, read from disk, not the chat.

environmentVariables.name: NOTION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Notion integration token. The integration needs access to the pages you attach files to.

environmentVariables.name: NOTION_UPLOAD_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Folders the server may upload files from, separated by : (; on Windows). Uploads are refused until this is set.
